what_happened: For about 16 hours (2026-10-13 15:00Z to 2026-10-14 07:50Z) the operator wrote detailed instructions in nearly every request across 44 jobs. They included the diagnosis, file and line references, root causes, the fixes, the sequencing, and the next improvement to make. BRIEF.md O2 says to ask for outcomes in a line or two with no step-by-step method, and O3 counts detailed instructions as interventions. Only the hand steps were logged as interventions. The detailed requests went unlogged until an outside review on 2026-10-14 pointed this out. The strategic judgment sat with the operator, not with Athena.
cause: Nothing checks a request against the O2/O3 rule when it is written or submitted. Intervention logging depends on the operator remembering to record it, and it was understood to cover only hand steps, not instruction-heavy requests. Athena also has no step of its own that finds the next improvement, so the operator filled that gap each time, and it felt like normal collaboration. Because no one noticed the gap, the intervention count looked low, and the review that caught it came only from outside.
prevention: Add a check at request intake. It flags requests that are over a few lines long or that contain file paths, line numbers, or words like "fix", "root cause" or "change X to Y". A flagged request is logged automatically as a gave-detailed-instructions intervention, and the operator is asked to restate it as an outcome in one or two lines. Separately, add an Athena step that proposes the next improvement from its own failure history, so the operator does not need to name it.
proposed_request: Add an intake check to the request-submission path. Flag any request that exceeds three lines or contains file paths, line numbers, or prescriptive fix wording. For each flagged request, automatically log a gave-detailed-instructions intervention against the resulting job, and prompt the operator to resubmit it as an outcome in one or two lines. Also add a periodic step that reads recent failure and introspection records and proposes the single next improvement as a draft request. Then backfill: for the jobs listed in this event (20261013-150709-b67z through 20261014-072452-c42z), confirm each has an intervention logged, and report the corrected intervention count.
